source.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
source.note: Figures are the City Clerk's annual remuneration reports, shown as published. Annual reports are included for 1999–2025. The City published the same annual series back to 1998, but no per-member 1998 report could be located, so 1998 is not included. Quarterly office-expense detail from 2013 is not included. Quarterly routine-disclosure detail (from 2013) is published separately on member pages as expenses-detail.json.
